fields.title: Deteriorating post-operative patient

phases.name: Reactions
questions: How are you feeling about what just happened?
What stood out to you first?

phases.name: Description
questions: Tell me what happened, in order.
What did you notice about the vital signs?

phases.name: Analysis
questions: What led you to call rapid response when you did?
What would have made the handoff stronger?
What other explanations did you consider?

phases.name: Application
questions: What will you do differently on your unit?

phases.name: Summary
questions: What are the three points to take away?

fields.checkIn: Before we leave, how is everyone doing? Anyone who wants to talk privately can stay.
fields.contentNotice: This case includes the death of a patient.
